result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an intersection under an elevated rail structure with faded crosswalk markings and a lack of accessible curb ramps. While sidewalks are present, the overall infrastructure appears aged and lacks modern safety features like pedestrian signals or high-visibility crossings.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps at the corner, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner near the pedestrian

hazards.name: Poor Lighting and Shadows
hazards.description: The elevated structure creates deep shadows that can obscure pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image under the tracks

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure that creates deep shadows and significant visual obstructions for both drivers and walkers. While basic infrastructure like marked crosswalks and curb ramps are present, the sidewalks are cluttered with commercial merchandise and the overall lighting under the structure appears inadequate.

hazards.name: Structural Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large steel pillars supporting the elevated rail structure block sightlines between motorists and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and center foreground, supporting the overhead structure

hazards.name: Sidewalk Clutter
hazards.description: Merchandise, equipment, and signage outside the corner store significantly narrow the effective width of the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk area in front of the brick building on the right

hazards.name: Poor Lighting and Shadows
hazards.description: The elevated structure creates a dark environment with high contrast shadows, making it difficult to see pedestrians in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area directly beneath the steel beams

interventions.title: Enhanced Underdeck Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-output LED luminaires on the underside of the elevated structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to move pedestrians past the visual obstruction of the pillars before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement and enforce a minimum clear path width for the sidewalk to ensure accessibility and safety.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure that creates significant visual obstructions with its support pillars. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and pedestrian signals are present, the faded crosswalk markings and uneven pavement surfaces pose risks to users.

hazards.name: Structural Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel pillars for the elevated rail obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground/midground

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalks
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface near the white van

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt near the crossing area increases trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway and gutter area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style high-visibility markings to improve the prominence of the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into a more visible position beyond the structural pillars.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Enhance lighting specifically under the elevated rail to eliminate dark spots and improve nighttime visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated rail structure that creates significant visual obstructions and deep shadows at the intersection. While sidewalks and marked crosswalks are present, the massive support pillars and parked vehicles severely limit sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Structural Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large steel pillars for the elevated rail structure are positioned near the intersection corners, blocking sightlines between turning vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center, supporting the overhead rail structure

hazards.name: Poor Lighting/Deep Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates high-contrast shadows that can make pedestrians less visible to drivers, especially during transition periods of the day.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway area under the elevated tracks

hazards.name: Parking Near Intersection
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk further restrict visibility at the corner.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the pillars and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Under-Structure Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian-scale lighting underneath the rail structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve sightlines for all road users.
